notes.title: Small Patch Released
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We just pushed a small patch with the following changes:
[list][*]Natural language recognition was slightly improved
[*]Some minor bug fixes
[*]Now the game doesn't comment on the absence of the player if it's paused or if you are reviewing the text at the end of the game
[*]The game checks the resolution and sets itself at fullscreen only once at startup[/list]

We're planning a sligthly bigger update in the future, which will allow you to review past conversations in the menu but there is no fixed date for it yet.

Thanks again for all your support! <3
